items.title: 3 Financial Stocks Built For Higher For Longer Rates
items.summary: Interest rates that refuse to fall, a strong October jobs report and a market suddenly rethinking the cost of money create a very different backdrop for U.S. stocks today. Higher-for-longer policy can pressure long-duration growth stories, yet some shorter-duration cash flow plays may find their footing. items.summary: The modeled fair value for Centrus Energy has been revised from US$225.15 to US$206.36, which points to a lower price target in the latest update.
